title: a train held at a station whose last recorded delay was negative never shows overdue, so watch never warns

evidence.case: the map's last delay for the train is -2 (it ran early), then it stops between stations; 40 minutes later the expected arrival at its next station is far behind the map's time
evidence.seen: overdue stays false and watch prints nothing new
evidence.expected: overdue becomes true once the train is clearly held, as for a train whose last delay was zero or positive
